# Setup

```{r, setup, include=FALSE}
resultsFolderAll = "singleGene/"
resultsPathAll = paste0("../results/", resultsFolderAll)

#resultsFolder_DirSelPos = "20230213_ER_40node_dirSelPos/"
#resultsPath_DirSelPos = paste0("../results/", resultsFolder_DirSelPos)
#resultsFolder_DirSelNeg = "20230126_ER_40node_dirSelNeg/"
#resultsPath_DirSelNeg = paste0("../results/", resultsFolder_DirSelNeg)
#resultsFolder_DirSelJoint = "20230126_ER_40node_dirSelJoint/"
#resultsPath_DirSelJoint = paste0("../results/", resultsFolder_DirSelJoint)
#resultsFolder_fluctSel = "20230126_ER_40node_fluctSel/"
#resultsPath_fluctSel = paste0("../results/", resultsFolder_fluctSel)
plotsFolderWithPath_singleGene = "../plots/singleGene"
if (!dir.exists(plotsFolderWithPath_singleGene))
{
  dir.create(plotsFolderWithPath_singleGene)
}


resultsFolderForTimePlots = "singleGene/net_2/"
resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath = paste0("../results/", resultsFolderForTimePlots)

#numReps = 10
adaptationResponseCriteria = 0.1

NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance = 5000
NUM_GENERATIONS = 30000
S_MAX = 100
```

Load packages & misc

```{r load-packages}
# Package list
packages <- c("nlme",
              "MuMIn", # for r.squared in lme models
              "ggplot2",
              "dplyr", # for inner_join
              "ggpubr", # for the pubclean theme
              "ggridges",
              "gridExtra",
              "cowplot", # for arranging plots
              "infotheo",
              "lme4",
              "car", # for vif measure
              "RColorBrewer", # for color palettes
              "latex2exp", # for latex notation in the plots
              "reshape2",
              "formattable", # for nice tables
              "htmltools", # for outputting the table
              "webshot", # for outputting the table
              "ggdist") # for half violin plots

# Install packages not yet installed
installed_packages <- packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(installed_packages == FALSE)) {
  install.packages(packages[!installed_packages])
}

# Packages loading
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

library(nlme)
```

# Directional selection (+)

## Mutable noise

### 1 gene example: time plots

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-read}
prmsV <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "prmsV_dirSelPos"), sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1)
sOpt <- prmsV["S_OPT", ] + prmsV["S_OPT_DELTA", ]
sOpt2 <- prmsV["S_OPT", ] - prmsV["S_OPT_DELTA", ]

phenoTwoColors = c("dirSelPos" = phenotypeColor, "stabSel" = grayCol)
varsTwoColors = c("dirSelPos" = varNoise, "stabSel" = grayCol)
genoNoiseTwoColors = c("dirSelPos" = genotypeNoiseColor, "stabSel" = grayCol)
genoSBasalTwoColors = c("dirSelPos" = genotypeSBasalColor, "stabSel" = grayCol)

# read MSB
MSBHist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableNoise.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(MSBHist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")

MSBNoises <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableNoise.noises"), header = FALSE)
colnames(MSBNoises) <- c("generation", "meanGenotEta")

MSBpop <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableNoise.pop"), header = FALSE)
sbasalThisGene <- unique(MSBpop[, 4])

# read dirSelPos
dirSelPos_hist <- MSBHist
dirSelPos_noises <- MSBNoises

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelPos_mutableNoise.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

noises <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelPos_mutableNoise.noises"), header = FALSE)
colnames(noises) <- c("generation", "meanGenotEta")
noises$generation <- noises$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

dirSelPos_hist <- rbind(dirSelPos_hist, hist)
dirSelPos_noises <- rbind(dirSelPos_noises, noises)
dirSelPos <- inner_join(dirSelPos_hist, dirSelPos_noises, by = "generation")
dirSelPos$meanGenotSBasal <- sbasalThisGene

# read dirSelNeg
dirSelNeg_hist <- MSBHist
dirSelNeg_noises <- MSBNoises

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelNeg_mutableNoise.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

noises <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelNeg_mutableNoise.noises"), header = FALSE)
colnames(noises) <- c("generation", "meanGenotEta")
noises$generation <- noises$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

dirSelNeg_hist <- rbind(dirSelNeg_hist, hist)
dirSelNeg_noises <- rbind(dirSelNeg_noises, noises)
dirSelNeg <- inner_join(dirSelNeg_hist, dirSelNeg_noises, by = "generation" )
dirSelNeg$meanGenotSBasal <- sbasalThisGene

# read stabSel
stabSel_hist <- MSBHist
stabSel_noises <- MSBNoises

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "stabSel_mutableNoise.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

noises <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "stabSel_mutableNoise.noises"), header = FALSE)
colnames(noises) <- c("generation", "meanGenotEta")
noises$generation <- noises$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

stabSel_hist <- rbind(stabSel_hist, hist)
stabSel_noises <- rbind(stabSel_noises, noises)
stabSel <- inner_join(stabSel_hist, stabSel_noises, by = "generation" )
stabSel$meanGenotSBasal <- sbasalThisGene

# read fluctSel
fluctSel_hist <- MSBHist
fluctSel_noises <- MSBNoises

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "fluctSel_mutableNoise.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

noises <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "fluctSel_mutableNoise.noises"), header = FALSE)
colnames(noises) <- c("generation", "meanGenotEta")
noises$generation <- noises$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

fluctSel_hist <- rbind(fluctSel_hist, hist)
fluctSel_noises <- rbind(fluctSel_noises, noises)
fluctSel <- inner_join(fluctSel_hist, fluctSel_noises, by = "generation" )
fluctSel$meanGenotSBasal <- sbasalThisGene

## join all

dirSelPos$sel <- "dirSelPos"
dirSelNeg$sel <- "dirSelNeg"
stabSel$sel <- "stabSel"
fluctSel$sel <- "fluctSel"

# just dirSelPos for now
dirPosAndStabSel <- rbind(dirSelPos, stabSel)
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-plot}
plot_mutNoise_pheno <- ggplot() +
  #ggplot(data = dirPosAndStabSel, aes(x = generation, y = meanP, fill = sel, group = sel, color = sel)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xmax = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
           ymin = sOpt - S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria, 
           ymax = sOpt + S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria,
           alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, color = "gray", alpha = 0.25, size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS, 
                   y = sOpt, yend = sOpt), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 20000, y = sOpt + 5, label = 'New optimum (+)', size = 3) + 
  #geom_segment(aes(x = 5000, xend = 15000, y = sOpt2, yend = sOpt2), linetype = "dashed") +
  #annotate('text', x = 12500, y = sOpt2 + 5, label = 'New optimum (-)') + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2, yend = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 7500, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2 + 5, label = 'Old optimum', size = 3) + 
  geom_point(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation <= NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], 
             aes(x = generation, y = meanP),
            color = grayCol, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation <= NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ],
            aes(x = generation, y = meanP),
            color = grayCol, size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ],
            aes(x = generation, y = meanP, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], 
             aes(x = generation, y = meanP, fill = sel, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  ylim(0, 100) +
  scale_color_manual("Selection", values = phenoTwoColors, labels = c("Directional", "Stabilizing")) +
  scale_fill_manual("Selection", values = phenoTwoColors, labels = c("Directional", "Stabilizing")) +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "Expression level")
plot_mutNoise_pheno
```

### All genes: boxplots

```{r boxplots-mutableNoise}
allGenes_mutableNoise <- read.table(paste0(resultsPathAll, "allGenes_mutableNoise.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
allGenes_mutableNoise_dirPosAndStabSel <- allGenes_mutableNoise[!(allGenes_mutableNoise$sel %in% c("dirSelNeg", "fluctSel")), ]
allGenes_mutableNoise_dirPosAndStabSel$sel <- factor(allGenes_mutableNoise_dirPosAndStabSel$sel, levels = c("dirSelPos", "stabSel"))

wilcox.test(allGenes_mutableNoise_dirPosAndStabSel$aveNormChangeVarP_A_mutNoise[allGenes_mutableNoise_dirPosAndStabSel$sel == "dirSelPos"], 
            allGenes_mutableNoise_dirPosAndStabSel$aveNormChangeVarP_A_mutNoise[allGenes_mutableNoise_dirPosAndStabSel$sel == "stabSel"])

stat.test <- allGenes_mutableNoise_dirPosAndStabSel %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(aveNormChangeVarP_A_mutNoise ~ sel) %>%
  rstatix::add_significance() %>%
  add_xy_position()

plot_var_allscens_mutNoise <- ggplot(allGenes_mutableNoise_dirPosAndStabSel,
                                     aes(x = sel, y = aveNormChangeVarP_A_mutNoise)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = sel, color = sel), position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0), size = 1, alpha = 0.75) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = sel, color = sel), alpha = 0.75, width = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.signif") +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Selection regime", y = expression(bold("Mean"~Delta~"Expr. level variance"))) +
  ylim(-1, 300) +
  scale_color_manual(values = varsTwoColors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = varsTwoColors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("dirSelPos" = "Directional", "stabSel" = "Stabilizing"))
plot_var_allscens_mutNoise
ggsave(filename = sprintf("plot_var_dirSelPosAndStabSel_mutNoise.png"),
       path = plotsFolderWithPath_singleGene,
       plot = plot_var_allscens_mutNoise, 
       device = "png", scale = 1.75, width = 6, height = 6, units = "cm",
       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE)
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-read}
# read dirSelPos

hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-plot}
plot_mutNoiseMean_pheno <- ggplot() +
  #ggplot(data = dirPosAndStabSel, aes(x = generation, y = meanP, fill = sel, group = sel, color = sel)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xmax = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
           ymin = sOpt - S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria, 
           ymax = sOpt + S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria,
           alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, color = "gray", alpha = 0.25, size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS, 
                   y = sOpt, yend = sOpt), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 20000, y = sOpt + 5, label = 'New optimum (+)', size = 3) + 
  #geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = 15000, y = sOpt2, yend = sOpt2), linetype = "dashed") +
  #annotate('text', x = 12500, y = sOpt2 + 5, label = 'New optimum (-)') + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2, yend = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 7500, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2 + 5, label = 'Old optimum', size = 3) + 
  geom_point(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation <= NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], aes(x = generation, y = meanP),
            color = grayCol, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation <= NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], aes(x = generation, y = meanP),
            color = grayCol, size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], aes(x = generation, y = meanP, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], aes(x = generation, y = meanP, fill = sel, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
    ylim(0, 100) +
  scale_color_manual("Selection", values = phenoTwoColors, labels = c("Directional", "Stabilizing")) +
  scale_fill_manual("Selection", values = phenoTwoColors, labels = c("Directional", "Stabilizing")) +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "Expression level")
plot_mutNoiseMean_pheno
```

### All genes: boxplots

```{r boxplots-mutableNoise}
allGenes_mutableNoiseMean <- read.table(paste0(resultsPathAll, "allGenes_mutableNoiseMean.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
allGenes_mutableNoiseMean_dirPosAndStabSel <- allGenes_mutableNoiseMean[!(allGenes_mutableNoiseMean$sel %in% c("dirSelNeg", "fluctSel")), ]

vars_A_and_PA <- allGenes_mutableNoiseMean_dirPosAndStabSel[ , c("gene", "sel", "aveNormChangeVarP_A_mutNoiseMean")]
levels(vars_A_and_PA$sel)[which(levels(vars_A_and_PA$sel) == "dirSelPos")] <- "dirSelPos_A"
colnames(vars_A_and_PA)[3] <- "aveChangeVarP"
vars_A_and_PA2 <- allGenes_mutableNoiseMean_dirPosAndStabSel[ , c("gene", "sel", "aveNormChangeVarP_PA_mutNoiseMean")]
levels(vars_A_and_PA2$sel)[which(levels(vars_A_and_PA2$sel) == "dirSelPos")] <- "dirSelPos_PA"
colnames(vars_A_and_PA2)[3] <- "aveChangeVarP"
vars_A_and_PA2 <- vars_A_and_PA2[-which(vars_A_and_PA2$sel == "stabSel"), ]
vars_A_and_PA <- rbind(vars_A_and_PA, vars_A_and_PA2)
vars_A_and_PA$sel <- factor(vars_A_and_PA$sel, levels = c("dirSelPos_A", "dirSelPos_PA", "stabSel"))

wilcox.test(vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelPos_A"], vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "stabSel"])
wilcox.test(vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelPos_PA"], vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "stabSel"])
wilcox.test(vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelPos_A"], vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelPos_PA"])

stat.test <- vars_A_and_PA %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(aveChangeVarP ~ sel) %>%
  rstatix::add_significance() %>%
  add_xy_position()
stat.test$custom.label <- ifelse(stat.test$p.adj <= 0.05, stat.test$p.adj, "ns")

plot_var_allscens_mutNoiseMean <- ggplot(vars_A_and_PA, aes(x = sel, y = aveChangeVarP)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = sel, color = sel), position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0), size = 1, alpha = 0.75) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = sel, color = sel), alpha = 0.75, width = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.adj.signif") +
  theme_pubclean() +

        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),

  ylim(-1, 300) +
  scale_color_manual(values = varsTwoColors_A_and_PA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = varsTwoColors_A_and_PA) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("dirSelPos_A" = "Directional,\nadaptive", "dirSelPos_PA" = "Directional,\npostadaptive", "stabSel" = "Stabilizing"))
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-read}
# read MSB
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-plot}
plot_mutMean_pheno <- ggplot() +
  #ggplot(data = dirPosAndStabSel, aes(x = generation, y = meanP, fill = sel, group = sel, color = sel)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xmax = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
           ymin = sOpt - S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria, 
           ymax = sOpt + S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria,
           alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, color = "gray", alpha = 0.25, size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = 15000, y = sOpt, yend = sOpt), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 20000, y = sOpt + 5, label = 'New optimum (+)', size = 3) + 
  #geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = 15000, y = sOpt2, yend = sOpt2), linetype = "dashed") +
  #annotate('text', x = 12500, y = sOpt2 + 5, label = 'New optimum (-)') + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2, yend = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 7500, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2 + 5, label = 'Old optimum', size = 3) + 
  geom_point(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation <= NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], aes(x = generation, y = meanP),
            color = grayCol, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation <= NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], aes(x = generation, y = meanP),
            color = grayCol, size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], aes(x = generation, y = meanP, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], aes(x = generation, y = meanP, fill = sel, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),

        strip.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),

        legend.position = "top") +
    ylim(0, 100) +

  scale_fill_manual("Selection", values = phenoTwoColors, labels = c("Directional", "Stabilizing")) +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "Expression level")
```

```{r boxplots-mutableNoise}
levels(sbasals_A_and_PA$sel)[which(levels(sbasals_A_and_PA$sel) == "dirSelPos")] <- "dirSelPos_A"
colnames(sbasals_A_and_PA)[3] <- "aveChangeSbasal"
sbasals_A_and_PA2 <- allGenes_mutableMean_dirPosAndStabSel[ , c("gene", "sel", "aveNormChangeGenotSbasal_PA_mutNoiseMean")]
levels(sbasals_A_and_PA2$sel)[which(levels(sbasals_A_and_PA2$sel) == "dirSelPos")] <- "dirSelPos_PA"
colnames(sbasals_A_and_PA2)[3] <- "aveChangeSbasal"
sbasals_A_and_PA2 <- sbasals_A_and_PA2[-which(sbasals_A_and_PA2$sel == "stabSel"), ]
sbasals_A_and_PA <- rbind(sbasals_A_and_PA, sbasals_A_and_PA2)
sbasals_A_and_PA$sel <- factor(sbasals_A_and_PA$sel, levels = c("dirSelPos_A", "dirSelPos_PA", "stabSel"))

wilcox.test(sbasals_A_and_PA$aveChangeSbasal[sbasals_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelPos_A"], sbasals_A_and_PA$aveChangeSbasal[sbasals_A_and_PA$sel == "stabSel"])
wilcox.test(sbasals_A_and_PA$aveChangeSbasal[sbasals_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelPos_PA"], sbasals_A_and_PA$aveChangeSbasal[sbasals_A_and_PA$sel == "stabSel"])
wilcox.test(sbasals_A_and_PA$aveChangeSbasal[sbasals_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelPos_A"], sbasals_A_and_PA$aveChangeSbasal[sbasals_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelPos_PA"])

stat.test <- sbasals_A_and_PA %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(aveChangeSbasal ~ sel) %>%
  rstatix::add_significance() %>%
  add_xy_position()
stat.test$custom.label <- ifelse(stat.test$p.adj <= 0.05, stat.test$p.adj, "ns")

plot_sbasal_allscens_mutMean <- ggplot(sbasals_A_and_PA, aes(x = sel, y = aveChangeSbasal)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = sel, color = sel), position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0), size = 1, alpha = 0.75) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = sel, color = sel), alpha = 0.75, width = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.adj.signif") +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Selection regime", y = expression(bold("Mean"~Delta~"basal expr. level")))  +
  ylim(-1.1, 60) +
  scale_color_manual(values = genoSBasalTwoColors_A_and_PA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genoSBasalTwoColors_A_and_PA) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("dirSelPos_A" = "Directional,\nadaptive", "dirSelPos_PA" = "Directional,\npostadaptive", "stabSel" = "Stabilizing"))
plot_sbasal_allscens_mutMean

       plot = plot_sbasal_allscens_mutMean,
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-read}
# read MSB
MSBHist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableNoiseMean.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(MSBHist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-read}
colnames(MSBNoises) <- c("generation", "meanGenotEta")

MSBSbasals <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableNoiseMean.sbasals"), header = FALSE) 
colnames(MSBSbasals) <- c("generation", "meanGenotSBasal")

# read dirSelPos

dirSelPos_sbasals <- MSBSbasals

colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

noises <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelPos_mutableNoiseMean.noises"), header = FALSE)

sbasals$generation <- sbasals$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

dirSelPos_noises <- rbind(dirSelPos_noises, noises)
dirSelPos_sbasals <- rbind(dirSelPos_sbasals, sbasals)
dirSelPos <- inner_join(dirSelPos_hist, dirSelPos_noises, by = "generation")
dirSelPos <- inner_join(dirSelPos, dirSelPos_sbasals, by = "generation")
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-plot}
plot_mutNoiseMean_pheno <- ggplot() +

           alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, color = "gray", alpha = 0.25, size = 1, linetype = "solid") +

                   y = sOpt, yend = sOpt), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 20000, y = sOpt + 5, label = 'New optimum (-)') +
```

```{r boxplots-mutableNoise}
allGenes_mutableNoiseMean <- read.table(paste0(resultsPathAll, "allGenes_mutableNoiseMean.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
allGenes_mutableNoiseMean_dirPosAndStabSel <- allGenes_mutableNoiseMean[!(allGenes_mutableNoiseMean$sel %in% c("dirSelPos", "fluctSel")), ]

vars_A_and_PA <- allGenes_mutableNoiseMean_dirPosAndStabSel[ , c("gene", "sel", "aveNormChangeVarP_A_mutNoiseMean")]
levels(vars_A_and_PA$sel)[which(levels(vars_A_and_PA$sel) == "dirSelNeg")] <- "dirSelNeg_A"
colnames(vars_A_and_PA)[3] <- "aveChangeVarP"
vars_A_and_PA2 <- allGenes_mutableNoiseMean_dirPosAndStabSel[ , c("gene", "sel", "aveNormChangeVarP_PA_mutNoiseMean")]
levels(vars_A_and_PA2$sel)[which(levels(vars_A_and_PA2$sel) == "dirSelNeg")] <- "dirSelNeg_PA"
colnames(vars_A_and_PA2)[3] <- "aveChangeVarP"
vars_A_and_PA2 <- vars_A_and_PA2[-which(vars_A_and_PA2$sel == "stabSel"), ]
vars_A_and_PA <- rbind(vars_A_and_PA, vars_A_and_PA2)
vars_A_and_PA$sel <- factor(vars_A_and_PA$sel, levels = c("dirSelNeg_A", "dirSelNeg_PA", "stabSel"))

wilcox.test(vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelNeg_A"], vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "stabSel"])
wilcox.test(vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelNeg_PA"], vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "stabSel"])
wilcox.test(vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelNeg_A"], vars_A_and_PA$aveChangeVarP[vars_A_and_PA$sel == "dirSelNeg_PA"])

  rstatix::wilcox_test(aveChangeVarP ~ sel) %>%
  rstatix::add_significance() %>%

plot_var_allscens_mutNoiseMean <- ggplot(vars_A_and_PA, aes(x = sel, y = aveChangeVarP)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = sel, color = sel), position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0), size = 1, alpha = 0.75) +
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-read}
# read MSB
MSBHist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableMean.hist"), header = FALSE)

# read dirSelPos

dirSelPos_sbasals <- MSBSbasals

colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

sbasals$generation <- sbasals$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

dirSelPos_sbasals <- rbind(dirSelPos_sbasals, sbasals)
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-plot}
plot_mutMean_pheno <- ggplot() +
  #ggplot(data = dirPosAndStabSel, aes(x = generation, y = meanP, fill = sel, group = sel, color = sel)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xmax = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
           ymin = sOpt - S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria, 
           ymax = sOpt + S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria,
           alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, color = "gray", alpha = 0.25, size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
                   y = sOpt, yend = sOpt), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 20000, y = sOpt + 5, label = 'New optimum (-)') + 
  #geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = 15000, y = sOpt2, yend = sOpt2), linetype = "dashed") +
  #annotate('text', x = 12500, y = sOpt2 + 5, label = 'New optimum (-)') + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2, yend = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 7500, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2 + 5, label = 'Old optimum') + 
  geom_point(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation <= NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], aes(x = generation, y = meanP),
            color = grayCol, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +

            color = grayCol, size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], aes(x = generation, y = meanP, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(data = dirPosAndStabSel[dirPosAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], aes(x = generation, y = meanP, fill = sel, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +

        strip.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
    ylim(0, 100) +
  scale_color_manual("Selection", values = phenoTwoColors, labels = c("Directional", "Stabilizing")) +
  scale_fill_manual("Selection", values = phenoTwoColors, labels = c("Directional", "Stabilizing")) +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "Expression level")
```

## Mutable noise

### 1 gene example: time plots

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-read}
prmsV <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "prmsV_dirSelPos"), sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1)
sOpt <- prmsV["S_OPT", ] + prmsV["S_OPT_DELTA", ]
sOpt2 <- prmsV["S_OPT", ] - prmsV["S_OPT_DELTA", ]

phenoTwoColors = c("fluctSel" = phenotypeColor, "stabSel" = grayCol)
varsTwoColors = c("fluctSel" = varNoise, "stabSel" = grayCol)
genoNoiseTwoColors = c("fluctSel" = genotypeNoiseColor, "stabSel" = grayCol)
genoSBasalTwoColors = c("fluctSel" = genotypeSBasalColor, "stabSel" = grayCol)

# read MSB
MSBHist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableNoise.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(MSBHist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")

MSBNoises <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableNoise.noises"), header = FALSE)
colnames(MSBNoises) <- c("generation", "meanGenotEta")

MSBpop <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableNoise.pop"), header = FALSE)
sbasalThisGene <- unique(MSBpop[, 4])

# read dirSelPos
dirSelPos_hist <- MSBHist
dirSelPos_noises <- MSBNoises

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelPos_mutableNoise.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

noises <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelPos_mutableNoise.noises"), header = FALSE)
colnames(noises) <- c("generation", "meanGenotEta")
noises$generation <- noises$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

dirSelPos_hist <- rbind(dirSelPos_hist, hist)
dirSelPos_noises <- rbind(dirSelPos_noises, noises)
dirSelPos <- inner_join(dirSelPos_hist, dirSelPos_noises, by = "generation")
dirSelPos$meanGenotSBasal <- sbasalThisGene

# read dirSelNeg

dirSelNeg_noises <- MSBNoises

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelNeg_mutableNoise.hist"), header = FALSE)

hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

dirSelNeg$meanGenotSBasal <- sbasalThisGene

# read stabSel
stabSel_hist <- MSBHist
stabSel_noises <- MSBNoises

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "stabSel_mutableNoise.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

noises <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "stabSel_mutableNoise.noises"), header = FALSE)
colnames(noises) <- c("generation", "meanGenotEta")
noises$generation <- noises$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

stabSel_hist <- rbind(stabSel_hist, hist)
stabSel_noises <- rbind(stabSel_noises, noises)
stabSel <- inner_join(stabSel_hist, stabSel_noises, by = "generation" )

# read fluctSel

fluctSel_noises <- MSBNoises

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "fluctSel_mutableNoise.hist"), header = FALSE)

## join all

dirSelPos$sel <- "dirSelPos"
dirSelNeg$sel <- "dirSelNeg"
stabSel$sel <- "stabSel"

# just fluctSel for now
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-plot}
plot_mutNoise_pheno <- ggplot() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xmax = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
           ymin = sOpt - S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria, 
           ymax = sOpt + S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria,
           alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xmax = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
           ymin = sOpt2 - S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria, 
           ymax = sOpt2 + S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria,
           alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, color = "gray", alpha = 0.25, size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS, 
                   y = sOpt, yend = sOpt), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 20000, y = sOpt + 5, label = 'Optimum 1', size = 3) + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
                   y = sOpt2, yend = sOpt2), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 20000, y = sOpt2 + 5, label = 'Optimum 2', size = 3) + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2, yend = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 7500, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2 + 5, label = 'Old optimum', size = 3) + 
  geom_point(data = fluctAndStabSel[fluctAndStabSel$generation <= NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], 
             aes(x = generation, y = meanP),
            color = grayCol, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = fluctAndStabSel[fluctAndStabSel$generation <= NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ],
            aes(x = generation, y = meanP),
            color = grayCol, size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(data = fluctAndStabSel[fluctAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ],
            aes(x = generation, y = meanP, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(data = fluctAndStabSel[fluctAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], 
             aes(x = generation, y = meanP, fill = sel, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  ylim(0, 100) +
  scale_color_manual("Selection", values = phenoTwoColors, labels = c("Fluctuating", "Stabilizing")) +
  scale_fill_manual("Selection", values = phenoTwoColors, labels = c("Fluctuating", "Stabilizing")) +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "Expression level")
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-read}

# read MSB
MSBHist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableNoiseMean.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(MSBHist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")

MSBNoises <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableNoiseMean.noises"), header = FALSE)
colnames(MSBNoises) <- c("generation", "meanGenotEta")

MSBSbasals <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableNoiseMean.sbasals"), header = FALSE) 
colnames(MSBSbasals) <- c("generation", "meanGenotSBasal")

# read dirSelPos
dirSelPos_hist <- MSBHist
dirSelPos_noises <- MSBNoises
dirSelPos_sbasals <- MSBSbasals

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelPos_mutableNoiseMean.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

noises <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelPos_mutableNoiseMean.noises"), header = FALSE)
colnames(noises) <- c("generation", "meanGenotEta")
noises$generation <- noises$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

sbasals <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelPos_mutableNoiseMean.sbasals"), header = FALSE)
colnames(sbasals) <- c("generation", "meanGenotSBasal")
sbasals$generation <- sbasals$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

dirSelPos_hist <- rbind(dirSelPos_hist, hist)
dirSelPos_noises <- rbind(dirSelPos_noises, noises)
dirSelPos_sbasals <- rbind(dirSelPos_sbasals, sbasals)
dirSelPos <- inner_join(dirSelPos_hist, dirSelPos_noises, by = "generation")
dirSelPos <- inner_join(dirSelPos, dirSelPos_sbasals, by = "generation")

# read dirSelNeg

dirSelNeg_sbasals <- MSBSbasals

dirSelNeg_sbasals <- rbind(dirSelNeg_sbasals, sbasals)
dirSelNeg <- inner_join(dirSelNeg_hist, dirSelNeg_noises, by = "generation")
dirSelNeg <- inner_join(dirSelNeg, dirSelNeg_sbasals, by = "generation")

# read stabSel

stabSel_sbasals <- MSBSbasals

## join all

dirSelPos$sel <- "dirSelPos"
dirSelNeg$sel <- "dirSelNeg"
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-plot}
  geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS, 
                   y = sOpt, yend = sOpt), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 20000, y = sOpt + 5, label = 'Optimum 1', size = 3) +
```

## Mutable mean

### 1 gene example: time plots

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-read}

# read MSB
MSBHist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableMean.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(MSBHist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")

MSBSbasals <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "mutSelBalance_mutableMean.sbasals"), header = FALSE) 
colnames(MSBSbasals) <- c("generation", "meanGenotSBasal")

# read dirSelPos
dirSelPos_hist <- MSBHist
dirSelPos_sbasals <- MSBSbasals

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelPos_mutableMean.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

sbasals <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelPos_mutableMean.sbasals"), header = FALSE)
colnames(sbasals) <- c("generation", "meanGenotSBasal")
sbasals$generation <- sbasals$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

dirSelPos_hist <- rbind(dirSelPos_hist, hist)
dirSelPos_sbasals <- rbind(dirSelPos_sbasals, sbasals)
dirSelPos <- inner_join(dirSelPos_hist, dirSelPos_sbasals, by = "generation")
dirSelPos$meanGenotEta <- 0

# read dirSelNeg
dirSelNeg_hist <- MSBHist
dirSelNeg_sbasals <- MSBSbasals

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelNeg_mutableMean.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

sbasals <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "dirSelNeg_mutableMean.sbasals"), header = FALSE)
colnames(sbasals) <- c("generation", "meanGenotSBasal")
sbasals$generation <- sbasals$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

dirSelNeg_hist <- rbind(dirSelNeg_hist, hist)
dirSelNeg_sbasals <- rbind(dirSelNeg_sbasals, sbasals)
dirSelNeg <- inner_join(dirSelNeg_hist, dirSelNeg_sbasals, by = "generation")
dirSelNeg$meanGenotEta <- 0

# read stabSel
stabSel_hist <- MSBHist
stabSel_sbasals <- MSBSbasals

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "stabSel_mutableMean.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

sbasals <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "stabSel_mutableMean.sbasals"), header = FALSE)
colnames(sbasals) <- c("generation", "meanGenotSBasal")
sbasals$generation <- sbasals$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

stabSel_hist <- rbind(stabSel_hist, hist)
stabSel_sbasals <- rbind(stabSel_sbasals, sbasals)
stabSel <- inner_join(stabSel_hist, stabSel_sbasals, by = "generation")
stabSel$meanGenotEta <- 0

# read fluctSel
fluctSel_hist <- MSBHist
fluctSel_sbasals <- MSBSbasals

hist <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "fluctSel_mutableMean.hist"), header = FALSE)
colnames(hist) <- c("generation", "meanP", "varP", "meanF")
hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

sbasals <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "fluctSel_mutableMean.sbasals"), header = FALSE)
colnames(sbasals) <- c("generation", "meanGenotSBasal")
sbasals$generation <- sbasals$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance

fluctSel_hist <- rbind(fluctSel_hist, hist)
fluctSel_sbasals <- rbind(fluctSel_sbasals, sbasals)
fluctSel <- inner_join(fluctSel_hist, fluctSel_sbasals, by = "generation")
fluctSel$meanGenotEta <- 0

## join all

dirSelPos$sel <- "dirSelPos"
dirSelNeg$sel <- "dirSelNeg"
stabSel$sel <- "stabSel"
fluctSel$sel <- "fluctSel"

fluctAndStabSel <- rbind(fluctSel, stabSel)
```

```{r timeplots-mutnoise-plot}
plot_mutMean_pheno <- ggplot() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xmax = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
           ymin = sOpt - S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria, 
           ymax = sOpt + S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria,
           alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xmax = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
           ymin = sOpt2 - S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria, 
           ymax = sOpt2 + S_MAX*adaptationResponseCriteria,
           alpha = 0.2, fill = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, color = "gray", alpha = 0.25, size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS, 
                   y = sOpt, yend = sOpt), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 20000, y = sOpt + 5, label = 'Optimum 1', size = 3) + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance + NUM_GENERATIONS,
                   y = sOpt2, yend = sOpt2), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 20000, y = sOpt2 + 5, label = 'Optimum 2', size = 3) + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2, yend = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 7500, y = (sOpt + sOpt2)/2 + 5, label = 'Old optimum', size = 3) + 
  geom_point(data = fluctAndStabSel[fluctAndStabSel$generation <= NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], 
             aes(x = generation, y = meanP),
            color = grayCol, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = fluctAndStabSel[fluctAndStabSel$generation <= NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ],
            aes(x = generation, y = meanP),
            color = grayCol, size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_line(data = fluctAndStabSel[fluctAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ],
            aes(x = generation, y = meanP, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 1, alpha = 0.75, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_point(data = fluctAndStabSel[fluctAndStabSel$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_forMutSelBalance, ], 
             aes(x = generation, y = meanP, fill = sel, group = sel, color = sel),
            size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  ylim(0, 100) +
  scale_color_manual("Selection", values = phenoTwoColors, labels = c("Fluctuating", "Stabilizing")) +
  scale_fill_manual("Selection", values = phenoTwoColors, labels = c("Fluctuating", "Stabilizing")) +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "Expression level")
```

```{r boxplots-mutableNoise}
  geom_boxplot(aes( fill = sel, color = sel), alpha = 0.75, width = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  #stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.signif") +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Selection regime", y = expression(bold("Mean"~Delta~"Intrinsic expr. noise"))) +
  ylim(-1, 230) +
  scale_color_manual(values = genoNoiseTwoColors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genoNoiseTwoColors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("fluctSel" = "Fluctuating", "stabSel" = "Stabilizing"))
plot_eta_allscens_mutMean
ggsave(filename = sprintf("plot_eta_fluctAndStabSel_mutMean.png"),
       path = plotsFolderWithPath_singleGene,
       plot = plot_eta_allscens_mutMean, 
       device = "png", scale = 1.75, width = 6, height = 6, units = "cm",
       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE)

wilcox.test(allGenes_mutableMean_fluctAndStabSel$aveNormChangeGenotSbasal_A_mutNoiseMean[allGenes_mutableMean_fluctAndStabSel$sel == "fluctSel"], 
            allGenes_mutableMean_fluctAndStabSel$aveNormChangeGenotSbasal_A_mutNoiseMean[allGenes_mutableMean_fluctAndStabSel$sel == "stabSel"])

stat.test <- allGenes_mutableMean_fluctAndStabSel %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(aveNormChangeGenotSbasal_A_mutNoiseMean ~ sel) %>%
  rstatix::add_significance() %>%
  add_xy_position()

plot_sbasal_allscens_mutMean <- ggplot(allGenes_mutableMean_fluctAndStabSel, aes(x = sel, y = aveNormChangeGenotSbasal_A_mutNoiseMean)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = sel, color = sel), position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0), size = 1, alpha = 0.75) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = sel, color = sel), alpha = 0.75, width = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.signif") +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Selection regime", y = expression(bold("Mean"~Delta~"basal expr. level")))  +
  ylim(-10, 10) +
  scale_color_manual(values = genoSBasalTwoColors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genoSBasalTwoColors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("fluctSel" = "Fluctuating", "stabSel" = "Stabilizing"))
plot_sbasal_allscens_mutMean
ggsave(filename = sprintf("plot_sbasal_fluctAndStabSel_mutMean.png"),
       path = plotsFolderWithPath_singleGene,
       plot = plot_sbasal_allscens_mutMean, 
       device = "png", scale = 1.75, width = 6, height = 6, units = "cm",
       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE)
```

## Combine into joint plot

```{r joint-plot}

title_M <- ggdraw() + draw_label("Mutable noise", fontface = 'bold', size = 20, x = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)
plot_M <- cowplot::plot_grid(plot_mutNoise_pheno, plot_mutNoise_var, plot_mutNoise_eta, plot_mutNoise_sbasal,
                             plot_eta_allscens_mutNoise, NA,
                             scale = c(0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95),
                             #rel_widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 0.75, 0.75),
                             labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", ""), label_size = 12, label_fontface = "bold", align = "v", ncol = 6)
plot_M <- cowplot::plot_grid(title_M, plot_M, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1), labels = NULL, ncol = 1)

title_MN <- ggdraw() + draw_label("Mutable noise and mean", fontface = 'bold', size = 20, x = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)
plot_MN <- cowplot::plot_grid(plot_mutNoiseMean_pheno, plot_mutNoiseMean_var, plot_mutNoiseMean_eta, plot_mutNoiseMean_sbasal,
                             plot_eta_allscens_mutNoiseMean, plot_sbasal_allscens_mutNoiseMean,
                             scale = c(0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95),
                             #rel_widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 0.75, 0.75),
                             labels = c("F", "G", "H", "I", "J", "K"), label_size = 12, label_fontface = "bold", align = "v", ncol = 6)
plot_MN <- cowplot::plot_grid(title_MN, plot_MN, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1), labels = NULL, ncol = 1)


title_N <- ggdraw() + draw_label("Mutable mean", fontface = 'bold', size = 20, x = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)
plot_N <- cowplot::plot_grid(plot_mutMean_pheno, plot_mutMean_var, plot_mutMean_eta, plot_mutMean_sbasal, 
                             NA, plot_sbasal_allscens_mutMean,
                             scale = c(0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95),
                             #rel_widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 0.75, 0.75),
                             labels = c("L", "M", "N", "O", "", "P"), label_size = 12, label_fontface = "bold", align = "v", ncol = 6)
plot_N <- cowplot::plot_grid(title_N, plot_N, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1), labels = NULL, ncol = 1)

plot_joint_singleGenes <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  
                                 plot_M,
                                 plot_MN,
                                 plot_N,

                                 labels = NULL,
                                 align = "v",
                                 ncol = 1)

ggsave(filename = paste0("plot_joint_singleGenes_fluctSel.png"),
       plot = plot_joint_singleGenes, 
       bg = "white",
       path = plotsFolderWithPath_singleGene, 
       device = "png", 
       scale = 2, height = 15, width = 25, units = "cm",
       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE)
```
